observations: Photo 0 shows the rear of a black DSLR camera with a viewfinder, buttons, and a dial labeled 'SET'. The text 'AF-ON' is visible near the top.
Photo 1 shows the front of the camera with the lens cap on. The brand 'Canon' is visible on the top, and 'EOS 6D' is printed on the right side.
Photo 2 shows the front of the camera from a slightly different angle, with the lens cap on. The 'Canon' logo and 'EOS 6D' are visible again.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust, especially on the grip and body.
No lens, battery, charger, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The seller claims it is 'body only' and 'neatly used'.

claims.claim: Neatly used Canon 6D camera. It is body only.
claims.evidence: Photos 1 and 2 show the camera body with no lens attached, and the 'Canon EOS 6D' branding is visible. The condition appears used but not heavily damaged.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may be missing or damaged, despite seller claiming 'body only'.
risks.proof: Photo showing the lens attached and removed, or a close-up of the lens mount.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no lens included

risks.risk: Internal damage or sensor issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera screen showing a test image or a video of the camera in use.

risks.risk: Battery or charger not included, or not functional.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger included, or a video showing them working.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no accessories included

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the lens attached and removed, or close-up of the lens mount.
Photo of the battery and charger included, or video showing them working.
Photo of the camera screen showing a test image or menu navigation.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
